questions.title: Had Apollo 11 landed humans on the Moon before August 1, 1969?
questions.description: This is a historical integration fixture. It checks execution and citation provenance, not forecasting skill.
questions.resolution_criteria: Yes if NASA records show Apollo 11's first crewed lunar landing occurred before August 1, 1969 UTC; otherwise No.
questions.fine_print: Distinguish the lunar landing from the first moonwalk and the return to Earth.
